ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all beneficial owners, directors, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, UK consolidated list, and Vanuatu domestic sanctions and terrorism designations. Politically Influential Person (PIP/PEP) status must be declared at onboarding and triggers enhanced due diligence, including source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification, business-objective validation against the low-risk helpdesk SaaS scope, and five-year compliance record retention under the Anti-Money Laundering and Proliferation Financing Act No. 10 of 2018.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Electronic Registry, Companies Office portal at https://www.vfsc.vu, with name availability search and reservation processed under the International Companies Act [Cap 222], s. 13.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be rendered in Latin script in English, French, or romanized Bislama, the official national languages. Every International Company name must end with Limited or Ltd. A non-Latin-script trading or brand name must be filed in romanized transliteration with a certified translation. Names that are identical or confusingly similar to an existing registered entity in Vanuatu are automatically refused.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant through its licensed registered agent must file a Notice of Objection with the VFSC Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, stating the grounds for review and attaching evidence of third-party consents or withdrawal of the conflicting name. The Registrar issues a written determination within 10 business days. An unfavorable determination may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu by judicial review under the Judicial Review Act [Cap 237] within 30 days. Name reservations may be extended for up to two further 30-day periods at the Registrar's discretion.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. A compliance-only virtual registered office in Port Vila maintained by a licensed registered agent is acceptable, provided the omnichannel helpdesk SaaS platform, customer data processing, and all substantive commercial operations are conducted outside Vanuatu and the International Company holds no local license to carry on business within Vanuatu. The registered agent must retain statutory records and decline arrangements that constitute carrying on business in-country per International Companies Act [Cap 222], s. 20.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low. Estimated 2-5% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection for a non-resident, low-risk helpdesk SaaS International Company with no Vanuatu premises, no local employees, and no local revenue collection. Probability rises to 25-35% if local economic nexus is established, sanctions screening produces hits, or the VFIU files suspicious transaction reports triggering enhanced monitoring.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act (Cap. 222), ss. 5-9 (Incorporation by Registration of Articles), s. 33 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), s. 34 (Certificate of Incorporation); Companies Act (Cap. 191) does not apply to International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry, Rue de la Treille, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-001 (Application for Incorporation) accompanied by executed Articles of Association and Statement of Particulars, submitted through the VFSC Online Registry Portal
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; the International Company may elect authorized share capital in the Articles of Association with no mandatory escrow, capital deposit, or capital duty obligation under the IC Act (Cap. 222), s. 11.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FAIRLY RESOLVED: (1) That the incorporation of the Company under the Vanuatu International Companies Act (Cap. 222) be and is hereby ratified and adopted. (2) That the issuance of the authorised shares to the founding subscriber(s) be approved and recorded in the register of members. (3) That the registered office address filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and the appointment of the licensed registered agent be adopted as the statutory address for service. (4) That the following persons be appointed first officers to hold office until replaced: [Name], Director; [Name], Secretary. (5) That the corporate seal, bank signatories, and delegated authority be established to enable execution of customer-support helpdesk subscription agreements and the opening of corporate bank accounts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Companies Registry (online name search and reservation desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the VFSC online portal or authorized registered agent. Obtain availability confirmation ensuring the name does not conflict with any existing Vanuatu company or international company and does not contain restricted words (Bank, Trust, Insurance) absent sectoral consent. Pay the reservation fee and secure the name for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Proposed name and approved suffix 'Limited' or 'Ltd'
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or flagged for confusing similarity, file an alternate name within the same application or submit a written appeal with supporting evidence of distinctiveness to the VFSC Registrar; the Registry responds within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Vanuatu registered agent (acting as filing intermediary) with VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Association in English or French including: corporate objects limited to permitted IC activities, authorized share structure, director and secretary provisions, and the registered office clause. Execute the Articles and Statement of Particulars before a witness or notary, and obtain consents to act from the proposed director and secretary.
required_dossiers: Statement of Particulars (Form IC-002) with subscriber names and addresses
Consent to act of each director and secretary
Passport copies and proof of residential address of directors and shareholders
Certificate of incorporation request from registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries the character of shareholders or the objects clause, provide supplementary source-of-funds or business-description documentation; amend the Articles by board written consent and re-file within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Companies Registry (Port Vila central filing desk)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed Articles of Association, Statement of Particulars, and consents via the VFSC online portal or in hard copy. Pay the official incorporation fee of approximately USD 300 (plus agent service fee) by bank transfer to the VFSC designated account or at the cashier. Retain the fee receipt as proof of filing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is rejected for incomplete particulars, rectify the noted deficiencies and refile within 14 days; any refusal notice may be appealed to the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Judicial Review Act, or resubmit with corrected documents via the agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Kit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies and International Companies Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfactory review, the Registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation under seal bearing the company registration number. Verify the legal name, date of incorporation, and registered office. Obtain the certified copies of the Articles and certificate, and prepare the corporate kit comprising share certificates, minute book, register of members, and company seal.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of registered Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains a clerical error in the company name or date, file a formal request for administrative rectification with the VFSC within 10 business days; the corrected certificate is reissued within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance Setup: Registered Office, Agent, and Banking
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry; licensed registered agent; bank relationship with international banking providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm the registered office and registered agent are officially appointed and recorded at VFSC. Obtain the Certificate of Incumbency and Good Standing certificate as evidence of legal existence. Open the corporate bank account for the helpdesk SaaS business using the incorporation package; file the annual return and pay the VFSC annual franchise tax (approximately USD 300 per annum) to maintain active status.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incumbency / register of directors
Statement of no tax status from VFSC
Bank account application with beneficial ownership declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires economic substance or source-of-funds explanation, provide a board resolution describing the low-risk Helpdesk SaaS activities and the payment rails (Stripe Billing, PayPal); if VFSC administratively strikes the company for unpaid annual fees, apply for reinstatement under the IC Act within 1 year by settling arrears and filing a reinstatement application.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and the Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce (ITT&C); no industry licensing board clearance is required for pure IT helpdesk services
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating or manufacturing permit required for a helpdesk SaaS operator under Vanuatu law; optional Foreign Investment Registration Certificate (FIRC) via VIPA if a physical Vanuatu branch with local staff is established (exempt for purely offshore International Companies without local premises)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change and Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Non-Scheduled Operation: exempt from a full EIA Report; the activity involves no physical manufacturing, extraction, or land disturbance; only a written environmental compliance self-assessment is recommended where office premises are maintained
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial wastewater discharge or VOC emissions applicable; compliance with the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations 2017 for E-waste (used ICT equipment must be routed to authorized recyclers and not to municipal landfill); office-generated putrescible waste to be collected under municipal contracts; ambient noise of server/telephony equipment within 50 dB(A) at boundary; end-of-life hardware exported only with DEPC e-scrap movement authorization

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Where a physical office is maintained, obtain a building occupancy permit from the municipal council (Port Vila Municipal Council or Luganville Municipal Council) following a structural inspection; secure fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Police Force Fire and Rescue Services covering means of egress, extinguishers, and emergency lighting; high-tech electrical installations require a wiring certificate per Electricity Act licensing standards; workplaces with employees must register with the Department of Labour and display a Certificate of Compliance under the Employment Act and be covered by the Workmen's Compensation Act; no explosives or hazardous processes clearance is applicable.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Customs and Inland Revenue Department (CIRD), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Government of Vanuatu; regulatory oversight of offshore International Companies is with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Tax and customs administration is executed through the ASYCUDA World single-window portal for customs and the CIRD VAT registry for domestic and importation purposes.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) is incorporated under the International Companies Act [CAP 222] and receives a unique VFSC Company Registration Number, which serves as its statutory tax identifier. The IC does not separately register for VAT or obtain an inland revenue TIN because it is statutorily exempt and prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents. To evidence tax-exempt status for banking and contracting counterparties, the IC requests from VFSC a Certificate of Good Standing and a Tax Exemption Certificate. If, contrary to the offshore profile, the IC or a related domestic vehicle makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu above the VAT threshold, it must submit Form VR-1 (VAT Registration Application) to the CIRD within 14 days, provide constitutional documents, evidence of place of business, and a resident tax representative, and will then be issued a VAT registration number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Vanuatu; exemption is mandatory and automatic for an IC under the International Companies Act, which provides that an IC and its operations, securities, and transactions are exempt from all taxes, duties, and charges. A foreign-owned entity may instead elect to incorporate as a domestic company, but Vanuatu currently imposes no income tax on domestic companies other than VAT and customs obligations. A non-resident supplier with Vanuatu taxable supplies may elect voluntary VAT registration on or after crossing the VUV 4,000,000 threshold; no hybrid mismatch or BEPS-related elections are operative in Vanuatu.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 [CAP 249]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 4,000,000 of taxable supplies in any rolling 12-month period (threshold in force as revised under the 2025 Budget Act; registration compulsory if exceeded; voluntary registration permitted below threshold).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API-based e-invoicing, or digital stamping mandate exists in Vanuatu as of this stage. VAT-registered businesses may issue tax invoices in approved paper or PDF formats containing prescribed particulars (seller name and VAT number, buyer name, invoice date, description, VAT-exclusive amount, VAT rate, and VAT amount). Customs exports are processed exclusively through ASYCUDA World, which requires electronic lodgment of export declarations and supporting digital attachments. CIRD has publicly indicated a phased modernisation roadmap toward electronic reporting, but no mandatory clearance or e-invoice validation requirement is yet operational.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to (i) the export of goods physically leaving Vanuatu evidenced by a customs export declaration; and (ii) the supply of services to a non-resident recipient where the benefit of the services is received outside Vanuatu, including offshore helpdesk and customer-support SaaS supplied by an International Company to foreign clients. The IC’s cross-border omni-channel helpdesk and conversational-bot cloud services qualify as exported services under Section 7 of the VAT Act. The supplier must hold written contracts, itemised service invoices, delivery/usage evidence, and payment records showing foreign currency settlement to substantiate the offshore supply.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (lodged via ASYCUDA World, approved exit confirmation)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill (for goods; for pure services, digital service delivery log and offshore recipient confirmation)
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/payment evidence proving receipt of export proceeds
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: CIRD may scrutinise export zero-rating claims up to four years retrospectively. Where zero-rating is claimed fraudulently or without sufficient export evidence, the VAT Act imposes a dishonesty penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded, plus interest, and criminal conviction may result in fines and imprisonment. Refunds already paid are clawed back with statutory interest, and repeated offending may trigger registration cancellation, disqualification of directors, and referral for tax evasion prosecution under the criminal code. For an International Company, loss of the statutory exemption or breach of the non-resident business prohibition can additionally trigger severe administrative penalties by VFSC, including strike-off and forfeiture of the offshore licence.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap 125]; regulates banks, foreign-exchange dealers, and money remitters under the Financial Institutions Act No. 6 of 1999, and houses the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) for AML/CFT supervision. International Companies are registered and supervised by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) under the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu has no exchange-control legislation in force and the Vatu (VUV) is fully convertible on both current and capital accounts, reflecting Vanuatu's acceptance of IMF Article VIII obligations; no approval, licence, or remittance restriction attaches to dividend distribution, profit repatriation, loan repayment, or capital disposal by International Companies. The RBV operates a managed-float arrangement that smooths the VUV against a trade-weighted basket of partner currencies. Practical convertibility is constrained only by thin offshore VUV liquidity, so settlement flows are executed through USD, AUD, NZD, or EUR correspondent channels. The FATF increased-monitoring designation raises bank-level due-diligence friction but creates no statutory convertibility or repatriation limits.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable. Vanuatu imposes no statutory surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no repatriation obligation for export proceeds. SaaS and helpdesk service-export receipts may be retained offshore, swept into a Vanuatu licensed-bank account, or held in foreign currency indefinitely, subject only to ordinary AML/CFT record-keeping, sanctions screening, and FIU reporting thresholds under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 11 of 2018.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency current account (USD/AUD/NZD/VUV) for gateway settlements and trade disbursements; separate Capital Escrow Account for share-capital injection and intercompany loan drawdown
Operational account (USD/EUR/AUD/VUV) for SaaS revenue cycling; segregated USD treasury account for FX spot and forward settlement
Operational foreign-currency account (USD-denominated) for international wire throughput
Operational account with USD/RMB/VUV capability for Asia-Pacific settlement corridors
Operational VUV account; capital accounts generally restricted to resident domestic operations requiring in-country economic nexus

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium for offshore digital EMIs. Vanuatu law does not prohibit foreign EMI servicing and no domestic EMI licensing regime exists; the binding constraints are correspondent-bank risk appetite (FATF increased-monitoring status), thin VUV clearing, and EMI country matrices, which generally exclude Vanuatu-registered International Companies (Wise, Airwallex, Mercury, and Payoneer typically decline). Workable treasury architecture: Stripe Billing and PayPal serve as customer-facing collection gateways, with merchant settlement in USD into the Tier-1 Vanuatu bank account; where Stripe's supported-country matrix does not directly admit a VU International Company, interpose a US (Stripe Atlas) or EU merchant-of-record entity that re-invoices the VU IC for the helpdesk SaaS. EMIs may be used only as nominal payout channels for contractors, never as primary treasury clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statute mandates director appearance; RBV AML/CFT rules permit identity verification by face-to-face contact or an equivalent-reliability remote process with a VFSC-licensed registered agent acting as professional referee. In practice, BSP and BRED accept fully remote video-KYC onboarding for low-risk, non-resident IC directors using apostilled passport copies, verified proof of address, and bank reference letters, subject to a recorded video interview with the compliance officer. NBV requires a physical visit of at least one director or authorised signatory to the Port Vila branch, with in-person signature verification before account activation. Every signatory must complete individual KYC; a board resolution and notarised power of attorney are required whenever an account operator is appointed outside Vanuatu.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu International Company presenting remote or undisclosed beneficial ownership, activating RBV/FIU ownership-transparency and VFSC beneficial-ownership-registry red flags
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]; VFSC certificate of good standing; certificate of incumbency identifying all directors and shareholders; VFSC beneficial-ownership filing receipt; notarised and apostilled passports of each UBO and director; bank reference from each UBO's home bank; corporate-structure chart evidencing SaaS operational substance; confirmation letter from the VFSC-licensed registered agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: FATF grey-list designation triggering enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds scrutiny, and sanctions-screening rejections on the Pacific corridor
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-wealth file for each UBO (three years of personal tax returns, asset statements, employment and business contracts); audited or accountant-reviewed financial statements of the parent/shareholder; executed SaaS subscription contracts and platform revenue reports from Stripe and PayPal; VU entity AML/CFT manual naming a compliance officer; written business plan confirming the helpdesk customer-support scope.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring-payment gateway mismatch (Stripe/PayPal gross settlements versus declared turnover) flagged as undisclosed third-party or trust funds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed merchant agreements with Stripe Billing and PayPal; consolidated gateway settlement reports reconciled to the nominal ledger on a daily-sweep basis; anonymised customer master list and subscription invoices; board minutes adopting the treasury settlement-sweep policy; contemporaneous intercompany agreements for any merchant-of-record re-invoicing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Government Fee Renewal (International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of each anniversary of incorporation; fee must be paid by the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of VT 10,000 plus VT 5,000 per month; failure to pay and file for 6 months may result in administrative strike-off and dissolution of the company

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory independent audit applies to a non-resident International Company; audit is required only where the company holds a VFSC financial services licence or where the Registrar imposes an audit condition under the International Companies Act
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No prescribed statutory GAAP for International Companies; IFRS is the accepted basis for any voluntarily prepared financial statements

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public beneficial ownership register. The licensed registered agent must obtain and retain current UBO information, confirm the accuracy of the register in connection with the annual return, and record any share transfer in the register of members within 30 days of the transfer

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$600 – US$1,800 per annum depending on the licensed registered agent
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required for a standard exempt International Company; if voluntarily audited, US$2,000 – US$4,000 per annum

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax; International Company (IC) enjoys full exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, and withholding tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Not applicable for tax purposes; VFSC Annual Return filed through the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) online portal for registry compliance.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VFSC annual return due within 30 days after each anniversary of incorporation; no corporate income tax return deadline exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No corporate income tax return is required for a Vanuatu International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident owners file no Vanuatu tax return; ongoing VFSC annual fees and registered agent filings must be maintained.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC annual return penalty is approximately VUV 10,000 plus late fees; no tax late-filing penalties apply due to zero corporate income tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double tax agreement (DTA) network; no treaty relief protocol or Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) process is applicable.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory rate for cross-border royalties and interest; no treaty rate reduction is required.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing law or mandatory Local File / Master File documentation threshold exists in Vanuatu.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu has no local Economic Substance Regulations (ESR); International Companies must maintain a registered office and local agent, and should demonstrate commercial substance where subjected to foreign anti-avoidance scrutiny.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the Vanuatu IC to conceal taxable income in the shareholder's resident jurisdiction or filing false returns abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Foreign tax penalties, criminal prosecution, and civil fraud assessments in the taxpayer's home jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally liable for restitution, travel bans, and imprisonment under applicable foreign tax evasion statutes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating without economic substance while generating passive income, leading to characterization as a shell or conduit company by foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty benefits, recharacterization of income, and global anti-base-erosion penalties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face civil restitution orders and personal assessments when the corporate veil is pierced.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain beneficial ownership records or facilitating money laundering through payment rails such as Stripe or PayPal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu AML/CFT fines up to VUV 1,000,000 per breach and suspension of any associated license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be subject to personal fines, travel bans, and imprisonment for wilful AML breaches.
